Quick Guide: Workspaces, Termux & Remote SSH
What works out of the box vs. 1-minute Termux / Tailscale / Cloudflare setup

• AI Home (\'internal\') & Android Folder (\'saf\'): work immediately out of the box with built-in POSIX shell (/system/bin/sh), Sora Editor, and local HTTP preview. • Termux (Local SSH) — 1-minute setup for full Linux (Python, Node.js, Git, compilers): 1) Install Termux (F-Droid or GitHub Releases). 2) Paste & run the 1-liner below in Termux: pkg update -y && pkg install -y openssh && passwd && sshd -p 2222 3) Run \'whoami\' in Termux to check your username (e.g. u0_a...), enter it below for 127.0.0.1:2222, and tap Save. • Remote PC / VPS SSH (no public IP needed): 1) Tailscale: install Tailscale on PC & phone -> connect to 100.x.y.z:22. 2) Cloudflare Access Tunnel: expose ssh://localhost:22 with cloudflared -> toggle \'Cloudflare Access tunnel (wss://)\' below.
What is MCP & How to Add Servers
Connect external tools over HTTP, SSE, or Termux/SSH Stdio

Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets the AI agent discover and call external tools (GitHub, databases, search, custom Python/Node scripts). • Streamable HTTP / SSE: connect to any remote or LAN MCP gateway URL (supports Bearer, Basic, API Key, and Cloudflare Access Service Tokens). • SSH Stdio: launches a CLI MCP server (npx / uvx / python3) directly inside your connected Termux or remote SSH profile — no web server required.
Zero-config Android speech out of the box + optional Whisper & XTTS-v2

• Out of the box (no keys or servers needed): select Built-in Android STT and Built-in Android TTS. • Fast Cloud Dictation (STT): paste a Groq or OpenAI API key to use Whisper. • Neural Voice Cloning (XTTS-v2): run xtts-api-server on your PC over Wi-Fi (http://192.168.x.x:8020) or behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, then tap \'Check XTTS\' to load speakers.

⚡ Turbo is OFF (full fonts, images & media)

• What ⚡ Turbo accelerates:
1. Network payload filter: blocks ad networks, analytics, tracking pixels, CMP banners, heavy web fonts (.woff2/.ttf), and background audio/video. Suppresses background image downloads while keeping full images when you open Agent (Live) or when AI takes a screenshot.
2. Instant UI & Early DOM Ready: forces 0s CSS animations, shrinks inter-step settle delays (15–35 ms), and returns as soon as live text is ready in DOM instead of stalling 3–4s on ad iframes.

• Honest limits: ⚡ Turbo does not bypass raw server/network ping on lightweight pages or speed up JS Markdown DOM parsing.

• Parallel Multi-Window AI Browser: AI can open up to 8 background websites simultaneously (open_parallel / tab_id), read them all at once, and switch between them freely without touching your Regular Browser.
✨ Free Microsoft Edge Neural TTS — natural voices (RU, EN, UA & 300+ more). Works for everyone out of the box with zero API keys or servers.
